name: manual_8320ab
claim: asyncio.wait_for raises a builtin TimeoutError whose str() is empty — at any containment boundary translate it into an explicit RuntimeError carrying the bound (e.g. provider invocation timed out after Ns) so error deltas and append-only ledgers record a real message

decisions.notes: Timeout test caught 'provider invocation failed: ' with no message; translating at the seam gave both the error delta and the ledger record a readable, bounded message.
